subject: Re: RFQ: Semaglutide injection pens - CASE-001
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for the offer. Before we can proceed, two points need to change:

1. Expiry: 10/27 (2027-10-31) is earlier than the minimum we can accept, 2028-06-30.
2. Lots: we need all 1,200 pens from a single lot; the offer splits them across 3 lots (A1001, A1002, A1003).

Could you offer 1,200 pens from a single lot with expiry on or after 2028-06-30, and confirm the price per pen and lead time?

Best regards,
Jamie Park
NeuroBiz

subject: Confirmation needed: Semaglutide pens for clinical trial - CASE-001
body:

Jamie Park
